I answered Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The answer comes from #inc-tansley-carrier-api, which I checked he's a member of. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka Sundaram posted there that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch's totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

The channel doesn't give an address or any other site details, so I told him "Southgate" is as specific as it gets.
